title: Thunderhead Bind
body:
Syntax: perform thunderhead bind <target>

Description: A Tempest Release attack that strikes one target. Paralysis briefly blocks the target's actions.  Requires Tempest Release and its revealed chakra natures, without a clan bloodline. Base damage: 203-235. 45% chance to inflict paralyzed. Unlocks at level 45. Costs 42 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 14 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
